class.name: NavMeshCarving
class.brief_description: Dynamic navmesh obstacle carving with a budgeted tile cache.
class.description: Walkable space is a grid of tiles holding convex polygons. Obstacles (polygons or circles grown by [member agent_radius]) are subtracted from the tiles they touch. Adding or removing an obstacle only marks the touched tiles dirty; [method update] rebuilds them under a per-call budget and re-links them to their neighbours. Rebuilt tiles are reported by [method consume_changed_tiles] so AI can repath. Polygon clipping and decomposition use [Geometry2D].

method.name: get_tile_size
method.description: Returns the tile edge length.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the covered area.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns a counter increased whenever [method update] rebuilt tiles.

method.name: get_tiles_rebuilt_total
method.description: Returns the number of tile rebuilds since [method setup].

method.name: setup
method.description: Creates a fully walkable tile grid over [param bounds].

method.name: set_walkable
method.description: Restricts walkable space to the given polygons (clipped into tiles).

method.name: add_obstacle
method.description: Adds or replaces an obstacle. [param shape] is a [PackedVector2Array] polygon or a dictionary [code]{center: Vector2, radius: float, segments: int}[/code]. Touched tiles are queued.

method.name: remove_obstacle
method.description: Removes an obstacle and queues the tiles it touched. Returns [code]false[/code] if it did not exist.

method.name: on_destroyed
method.description: Destruction hook: a broken barricade or wall stops blocking the navmesh. Equivalent to [method remove_obstacle].

method.name: has_obstacle
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the obstacle exists.

method.name: pending_tiles
method.description: Returns the number of tiles waiting to be rebuilt.

method.name: update
method.description: Rebuilds up to [param max_tiles_per_call] dirty tiles ([code]<= 0[/code] means all). Returns the number rebuilt.

method.name: consume_changed_tiles
method.description: Returns and clears the tiles rebuilt since the last call.

method.name: tile_version
method.description: Returns how often [param tile] was rebuilt.

method.name: tile_count
method.description: Returns the tile grid size.

method.name: tile_of
method.description: Returns the tile containing [param point].

method.name: polygons_in_tile
method.description: Returns the convex polygons of [param tile].

method.name: is_walkable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param point] is on a walkable polygon (the boundary counts).

method.name: find_path
method.description: Finds a smoothed path (A* over polygons, then funnel). Returns an empty array when either end is blocked or unreachable.

method.name: path_affected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any segment of [param path] passes through one of the [param changed] tiles.

method.name: is_convex
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param polygon] is convex.

method.name: polygon_area
method.description: Returns the absolute area of [param polygon].

members.member: Radius by which obstacles are grown when added.
